about: Thirty made-up patients. No real person is described. The lines were written by an AI assistant and have not been read by a native speaker. The level each one is expected to get was set by the same assistant from the published tools in docs/SOURCES.md (mainly the WHO, ICRC and MSF Interagency Integrated Triage Tool), not by a clinician. They exist to demonstrate Mukoti without personal data and to check that it does not miss an emergency. 'expect' is the lowest acceptable level.

en.worse: No, it is about the same.
en.chronic: No, I have no long-term illness.
en.medicines: No, I am not taking any medicines.
en.fever: No, I do not have a fever.
en.neck: No, my neck is not stiff.

patients.title: A mother whose baby cannot breathe
patients.about: Eight-month-old with trouble breathing and fever. The alarm should go on the first sentence.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu ane mwedzi misere ari kutadza kufema, uye ari kupisa muviri.

patients.title: A child with diarrhoea who has stopped drinking
patients.about: Starts as an ordinary complaint. The danger sign only comes out when Mukoti asks about drinking.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu ane manyoka kubva nezuro.

answers.drinking: Kwete, haachagoni kunwa kana kuyamwa, uye anorutsa zvese zvaanodya.

patients.title: A pregnant woman who is bleeding
patients.about: Seven months pregnant, bleeding since morning.
patients.opening: Ndine pamuviri pemwedzi minomwe, ndatanga kubuda ropa mangwanani ano.

patients.title: A child who had fits in the night
patients.about: Three-year-old with two fits.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu ane makore matatu abatwa nepfari kaviri husiku hwapfuura.

patients.title: A man bitten by a snake
patients.about: Bitten on the leg in the field.
patients.opening: Murume wangu arumwa nenyoka pagumbo tiri kumunda.

patients.title: A grandmother who fainted
patients.about: Fainted at home and is now confused.
patients.opening: Mbuya vangu vafenda kumba, vazomuka asi vava kutaura zvisinganzwisisike.
patients.why: Recent fainting and confusion are yellow criteria for an adult.

patients.title: A man with thoughts of ending his life
patients.about: Has not slept for weeks.
patients.opening: Ndave nemavhiki ndisingarari, uye ndava kufunga kuzviuraya.

patients.title: A deep cut that will not stop bleeding
patients.about: Cut on the arm with a knife.
patients.opening: Ndazvicheka nebanga paruoko, ropa riri kubuda rakawanda uye harisi kumira.

patients.title: A boy with asthma who is struggling to breathe
patients.about: Ten-year-old, in English.
patients.opening: My son is ten. He has asthma and he has been struggling to breathe since last night.

answers.breathing: Yes, he is struggling to breathe.

patients.title: A three-week-old baby with fever
patients.about: Hot and not feeding.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu ane mavhiki matatu ari kupisa muviri uye haasi kuyamwa.

patients.title: A man with chest pain, in English
patients.about: Shows Mukoti working in English. Chest pain must never be left in the routine queue.
patients.opening: I have a very bad pain in my chest since this morning, and I am sweating.

answers.chronic: Yes, I have high blood pressure.
answers.where: In the middle of my chest.

patients.why: Acute chest pain in a person over 50 is a red criterion.

patients.title: A man with a bad headache, fever and a stiff neck
patients.about: No single emergency word, but a combination a nurse should see ahead of the queue.
patients.opening: Ndine musoro unorwadza zvakanyanya, ndiri kupisa muviri, uye mutsipa wangu wakaoma.
patients.why: Stiff neck with fever and headache: 'any two of' is a red criterion.

patients.title: A child with blood in the stool
patients.about: Four-year-old.
patients.opening: Mwana ane makore mana ane manyoka ane ropa kubva nezuro.

patients.title: A pregnant woman with a high fever
patients.about: Five months pregnant, fever and chills, no bleeding.
patients.opening: Ndine pamuviri pemwedzi mishanu, ndiri kupisa muviri zvakanyanya uye ndiri kutonhorwa.

patients.title: A child scalded with hot water
patients.about: On the arm and chest.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu atsva nemvura inopisa paruoko nepadumbu.

patients.title: A diabetic with an infected foot wound
patients.about: In English.
patients.opening: I have sugar diabetes, and the wound on my foot is swollen and smells bad.

patients.title: Severe abdominal pain since the night
patients.about: Cannot stand up straight.
patients.opening: Ndine dumbu riri kurwadza zvakanyanya kubva husiku, handisi kugona kumira ndakatwasuka.

patients.title: Three weeks of cough, now with blood
patients.about: Adult man.
patients.opening: Ndave nemavhiki matatu ndichikosora, uye nezuro ndakosora ropa.

patients.title: A fall from a ladder
patients.about: In English. Thinks the arm is broken.
patients.opening: I fell from a ladder and I think my arm is broken.

patients.title: A woman with a headache and a cough
patients.about: An ordinary visit: six questions and a routine note.
patients.opening: Ndine musoro uri kurwadza uye ndiri kukosora.

patients.title: A woman collecting her blood pressure tablets
patients.about: Nothing is wrong: she only needs a refill. Mukoti should keep it short.
patients.opening: Ndauya kuzotora mapiritsi angu eBP, apera.

patients.title: A child with an itchy rash
patients.about: Six-year-old, playing and eating normally.
patients.opening: Mwana wangu ane makore matanhatu ane mapundu anovava pamaoko kwevhiki.

patients.title: Backache after lifting a sack
patients.about: Adult man.
patients.opening: Ndine musana uri kurwadza kubva pandakasimudza saga svondo rapfuura.

patients.title: A family planning injection
patients.about: Checks that an injection is not read as an injury.
patients.opening: Ndauya kuzobaiwa jekiseni rekuronga mhuri.

patients.title: A cold, in English
patients.about: Runny nose and sore throat.
patients.opening: I have a runny nose and a sore throat for three days.

patients.title: A toothache
patients.about: Two days.
patients.opening: Ndine zino riri kurwadza kwemazuva maviri.

patients.title: A baby due for immunisation
patients.about: A well child.
patients.opening: Ndauya nemwana kuzobaiwa majekiseni ake emwedzi mipfumbamwe.

patients.title: Itchy eyes, in English
patients.about: Since yesterday.
patients.opening: My eyes are itchy and red since yesterday.

patients.title: A cold, with every danger sign denied
patients.about: Checks that 'no trouble breathing' is not read as trouble breathing.
patients.opening: Ndine dzihwa nechipfuva kwemazuva matatu.

patients.title: Period pain
patients.about: Checks that ordinary menstrual bleeding is not read as heavy bleeding.
patients.opening: Ndine dumbu rinorwadza pandinenge ndiri kumwedzi.
